title: Keep it safe, and start next term
headline: Keep it *safe*, and start next term
sub: Names shown only to those who may see them; a new term in minutes.

recap.en: Names, phones, money. How does Bright Hill keep it safe?
recap.pcm: Names, phones, money. How Bright Hill go keep am safe?

closing.en: That is a term at Bright Hill. Start your free trial.
closing.pcm: Na so one term for Bright Hill be. Start your free trial.

flow.action: Turns his phone face-down on the desk, looks up and gives a firm but kind look
flow.setting: the bursar's office at Bright Hill Academy in Ikorodu: a wooden desk under a ceiling fan, grey filing cabinets, green fee ledgers stacked, a window onto the yard

flow.action: Closes her term planner, folds her hands and smiles quietly at the empty yard through the window
flow.setting: the proprietor's office at Bright Hill Academy: a bookshelf, a framed school crest, a term planner on a dark desk, soft morning light

flow.action: Closes and locks the green iron gate at dusk, waves up at someone off-screen and smiles
flow.setting: the green iron gate of Bright Hill Academy in Ikorodu: a cream two-storey classroom block with a pine-green stripe, a red-earth yard, a flame tree, a gatehouse with a folding stool, evening light

en: Funmi is a clerk. Her role may not see names.
Names are hidden: each child is an admission number.
Even the parent's phone number is masked.
On Mr Ibe's phone, his role may see names, so they show.
At year end, he opens Classes, terms and fees.
Promotion: each class moves up to the next.
Exceptions are listed, and he can change one.
Dami repeats, and stays in Primary four.
He promotes the year, and confirms. It happens once.
The new year's First term: Fees.
Its fees are empty. Copy from last term.
Then he starts First term, and confirms.
